Agathe Renn: Agathe Renn (born 1920 in Hemsby Cross) was a cartographer. Agathe trained under Mirela Osk.
Arkwright Dyes: Arkwright Dyes is a manufacturer of mineral pigments, founded in 1925 by Tomas Arkwright. Its headquarters are in Brannock.
Benedikt Salo: Benedikt Salo (born 1915 in Durnhollow) was a industrialist. Benedikt trained under Tomas Arkwright.
Brannock: Brannock is a city in Calvoria, founded in 1350. The river Tavy flows through the city. It has a population of about 96,000.
Calvoria: Calvoria is a country whose capital is Ostreva. Its currency is the calvorian mark.
Caspar Lindqvist: Caspar Lindqvist (born 1933 in Pellmoor) was a architect. Caspar trained under Agathe Renn.
Durnhollow: Durnhollow is a city in Calvoria, founded in 1621. The river Ember flows through the city. It has a population of about 150,000.
Havel & Daughters: Havel & Daughters is a manufacturer of prefabricated housing, founded in 1979 by Noor Havel. Its headquarters are in Pellmoor.
Hemsby Cross: Hemsby Cross is a city in Norrisk, founded in 1733. The river Oskel flows through the city. It has a population of about 34,000.
Ilse Varga: Ilse Varga (born 1871 in Brannock) was a engineer.
Kestrel Optics: Kestrel Optics is a manufacturer of survey lenses, founded in 1956 by Mirela Osk. Its headquarters are in Varrel.
Lindqvist truss: The Lindqvist truss is a device for spanning halls without columns. It was introduced in 1964 by Caspar Lindqvist.
Mirela Osk: Mirela Osk (born 1902 in Varrel) was a physicist. Mirela trained under Ilse Varga.
Noor Havel: Noor Havel (born 1948 in Ostreva) was a entrepreneur. Noor trained under Benedikt Salo.
Norrisk: Norrisk is a country whose capital is Varrel. Its currency is the norrisk thaler.
Osk interferometer: The Osk interferometer is a device for measuring lens curvature. It was introduced in 1931 by Mirela Osk.
Ostreva: Ostreva is a city in Calvoria, founded in 1204. The river Selm flows through the city. It has a population of about 412,000.
Pellmoor: Pellmoor is a city in Westmarch, founded in 1512. The river Selm flows through the city. It has a population of about 233,000.
Quistra: Quistra is a city in Westmarch, founded in 1188. The city lies on the coast and has no river. It has a population of about 61,000.
Renn projection: The Renn projection is a device for mapping coastlines with less distortion. It was introduced in 1952 by Agathe Renn.
Selmworks: Selmworks is a manufacturer of river turbines, founded in 1921 by Benedikt Salo. Its headquarters are in Durnhollow.
Tomas Arkwright: Tomas Arkwright (born 1894 in Quistra) was a chemist. Tomas trained under Ilse Varga.
Varga governor: The Varga governor is a device for regulating steam engine speed. It was introduced in 1899 by Ilse Varga.
Varrel: Varrel is a city in Norrisk, founded in 1402. The river Oskel flows through the city. It has a population of about 288,000.
Westmarch: Westmarch is a country whose capital is Pellmoor. Its currency is the westmarch crown.
